scientific_limitations: Finite deterministic Leslie-plus population matrices with fixed survival parameters; absolute matrix-entry fertility sensitivity rather than elasticity, cost-weighted management or stochastic extinction. The staircase family has reproduction only from the terminal class; historical priority of this exact classification remains provisional.
title: A sharp terminal-fecundity sensitivity staircase in plus-class population matrices
